text: ロケットだん　ふっかつの　ひ　まで　この　ジムで　たいせいを　たてなおすのだ！

structure.jp: ロケットだん　ふっかつの　ひ　まで
structure.en: until the day Team Rocket is revived

structure.jp: たいせいを　たてなおすのだ！

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end makes the statement firm, like announcing a decision. たてなおすのだ = 'I will regroup, that's what'.

patterns.name: 〜まで
patterns.explanation: まで after a time means 'until' that time. ふっかつの　ひ　まで = 'until the day of the revival'.
